senses.gloss: m. (preced. wds.) servant, attendant, esp. the disciple ministering to the master.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 62a:1-18">Ber. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>א״ל</he> … <he>לשַׁמְּעֵיה</he> R. Z. said to his attendant; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 33b">R. Hash. 33ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 103b:6">Pes. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ מדעתיה וכ׳</he> my attendant did it of his own accord; a. fr.
